text:
maria-sales: Hey team — client's demo started and we're seeing intermittent 5xxs from edge-router during burst. Demo link: https://demo.acme.example. Logs attached below.
evan-support: Can you paste the last 30s of the edge logs? 5xx code? timeout? OOM?
maria-sales: here's the tail:
```
[edge] 2024-09-15T14:22:31Z 502 upstream reset: swarm-burstpool-elb(10.2.1.45)
[edge] 2024-09-15T14:22:33Z 503 overload: capacity throttle triggered
[router] 2024-09-15T14:22:35Z 504 backend timeout after 10s
```
li-eng: That looks like the pool exhausted and requests were being queued then dropped. What are their concurrent reqs?
maria-sales: POC was sending ~80 qps with 30 token avg, tail bursts to 200 qps.
sam-oncall: Autoscaler logs show a 90s scale up delay; burstpool didn't spin up because of region quota. I'm pulling quota errors.
deploy-bot: scale_event: requested 4 -> provisioned 0 (quota_exceeded)
evan-support: If it's quota, fallback routing should hit Dedicated backup — did they have fallback enabled?
maria-sales: They had 'allow_fallback' false in the config for the trial due to data residency.
li-eng: Ok ; can we temporarily flip to a compatible region fallback just for the demo? If not, advise reduce concurrency or enable prewarm burstpool.
maria-sales: Client won't enable region fallback. What's the quickest mitigation?
li-eng: Two options: 1) Reduce client concurrency to 20-30 qps and add prefix caching. 2) Increase model shard per instance to handle more throughput (requires restart).
evan-support: For immediate fix, ask them to throttle by token and enable short-lived retries with jitter. Also we can raise the burstpool cap for 30m — but needs approvals.
maria-sales: I asked sales engineering — they approved temporary cap. Sam, can you open an emergency cap increase and set burstpool to +3 GPUs for 45m?
sam-oncall: Opening request now: INC-7893. Patch applied in ~120s. Will monitor.
maria-sales: Thanks. I'll tell the client to throttle to 25 qps meanwhile.
li-eng: Also let's collect a sample request_id for a failed request so we can trace KV-cache state. maria-sales: sample id: req_20240915_6223A
evan-support: Got it. After scale, check `curl -H "X-Req-Id: req_20240915_6223A" https://edge/redwood` and paste headers.
maria-sales: Will do. I'll update in thread in 2 minutes.
sam-oncall: Patch complete. Burstpool +3 GPUs live. Monitoring.
maria-sales: Demo resumed, errors dropped. Client happy. Will follow up with presales about adding region fallback to ent contract.
li-eng: Add a note to the POC doc: recommended prewarm and fallback for >50 qps demos. Also include autoscale tuning (scale window 60s -> 30s) and quota playbooks.
evan-support: I'll create a postmortem checklist and include commands we ran.
maria-sales: Perfect — thanks all :rocket:
